messages:
sara: heads up — prod alerts from monitoring: p99 for text-generation route jumped from 180ms -> ~2.3s starting 09:20 UTC for tenant `acme` :eyes:
ben: saw that, logs show a cluster-wide uptick around same time. Any recent config changes to continuous-batcher?
matt: i rolled a change to lower `batcher.max_wait_ms` from 80 -> 10 for the low-latency experiment at 09:10 UTC (canary on pool-gamma).
luis: lowering max_wait should reduce tail, curious why p99 increased. do we have request size distribution?
kevin-support: customer reported higher latency and some `429` retries ripple. they pasted a sample timestamped trace. linking here: https://redwood.internal/traces/ACME-0910 (internal)
ops-bot: deploy `canary/batcher-tune-2026-03-11` completed to pool-gamma @ 09:12 UTC.
ben: looking at traffic, pool-gamma handles many small prompts. reducing wait to 10ms collapsed batching and increased microbursts hitting the runtime with lower batch sizes -> CPU/GPU ineff more frequent. saw queue churn at the coalescer.
sara: quick repro steps for infra: run a synthetic of 300rps with 80% small prompts (<64 tokens) against pool-gamma with the new setting and compare p95/p99.
matt: running now. attaching quick perf sample: ```
# before (80ms): p95 220ms p99 340ms
# after 10ms:  p95 190ms p99 2.1s
```
luis: that aligns with microburst problem — too-small wait produces many tiny batches; overhead & KV-cache churn dominates for short prompts. we also see more `auth` token validation retries in logs because of rate-limited KMS calls (side-effect).
kevin-support: customer also saw intermittent `401` spikes — likely unrelated but timing matches the batch change window. can we throttle KMS or cache creds longer as mitigation?
ben: immediate mitigations we can try: 1) rollback wait to 60ms on pool-gamma, 2) enable adaptive-grace-window (experiment flag) to allow slightly higher wait when batcher sees tiny prompts, 3) increase `batcher.max_batch_size` to absorb microbursts.
infra-bot: applied temporary rollback on pool-gamma wait -> 60ms @ 09:40 UTC (manual). Monitoring will reflect in ~2min.
matt: post-rollback quick numbers: p99 dropped to ~380ms within 90s. customer notes latency improved.
sara: good. action items: - matt to revert experiment and add a canary plan that includes small-prompt traffic mix - luis to add KMS cache instrumentation & consider longer TTL for creds - ben to draft runbook steps for batcher tuning (parameters to try: max_wait_ms, grace_window_ms, max_batch_size)
luis: for runbook, add a quick CLI to reproduce: ```bash
# reproduce microburst
wrk -t4 -c50 -d60s -s scripts/short_prompt.lua http://pool-gamma-gen
```
kevin-support: I will notify acme with incident update and include repro / mitigation timeline.
ops-bot: scheduled follow-up: perf postmortem meeting tomorrow 10:30 UTC.
sara: notes for postmortem: emphasize tradeoff curve — aggressive wait reductions can worsen p99 for predominantly short prompts due to batching overhead + downstream auth/cache pressure. add recommended defaults per workload profile. :memo:
ben: i'll draft recommended default table (small prompts / mixed / long prompts) and push to docs. :shipit:
